rn-web.settings: AI Art Create AI Images Turns a finished drawing into an AI picture based on it. What turning this on does One tap on a finished drawing, and it comes back as a storybook picture — same colors, same character, same big smile. 1 They draw 2 One magic tap 3 Ta-da! The first 10 pictures are free — nothing to set up, no card. After that, use your own OpenAI key — saved on this device only.
